# GimbalControl (command)

Gimbal Control - simpler mode-based control. Source: DataGimbalControl.java, field order (pitch/roll/yaw/mode_byte) and mode_byte=(mode<<6)|(isReset<<5) confirmed byte-for-byte 2026-10-24 against real dji.pilot decompile.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** dji.pilot decompile, DataGimbalControl.java. mode: 0=YawNoFollow, 1=FPV, 2=YawFollow (enum also has OTHER=100, not used here). Was scripts/re/duml_commands.py's `GimbalControl`/`gimbal.control`.
